# Check timestamp units even when both APIs use PRTime

841 adds maildir file modification time as envelope time. The fixed accepted scanner passes GetLastModifiedTime output directly to onStartMessage; StoreIndexer passes it unchanged to the parser. Gecko nsIFile documents milliseconds, while NSPR PRTime documents microseconds. The parser seeds its date from that value and later calls SetDate; a successfully parsed Date header replaces the envelope value. Thus the concern applies to the envelope fallback path. This is an unresolved static unit mismatch, despite matching C++ types. No repair was reproduced, no fix was made, and the inspected dateless test does not explicitly select both store types. The inspected Gecko documentation is at a separately recorded accepted revision; exact comm-to-Gecko revision pairing was not verified.

Scope: Maildir scanner timestamp units.
